text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Yaeno. Fancy running into you here. Might I ask what you're reading?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A martial arts guidebook, and a fascinating one indeed. The original manuscript was written over a century ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A martial arts guidebook… written more than a hundred years ago, you say? That sounds like quite the challenging read.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I thought the same thing at first. It's been modernized though, so it's surprisingly easy to make sense of.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Certain parts seem like they could apply to races, too, like the detailed descriptions of how to steel your heart and mind.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I could recommend a few martial arts guidebooks for you, if you like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Why, thank you. If it's no trouble, then I accept your kind offer.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll look over my collection immediately. Then, if you want to learn more about martial arts, we can practice together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: You'd be willing to teach me? How wonderful. I've never had the opportunity to practice martial arts. I hope you'll allow me to address you as "Master" during our sessions.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, an inexperienced fledgling like myself is unworthy of such a title.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Instead, I suggest we push one another to new heights as rivals.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Gladly. I shall endeavor to reach your level, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan reads through all the martial arts guidebooks she's been recommended, learning much in the process.
